paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average performance scores of several language models across three categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The horizontal axis, labeled "Percentage," represents the performance scores, ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick intervals of 20%. The vertical axis, labeled "Models," displays the names of the language models in alphabetical order, including gpt-40, Qwen2, interml3, glm-4, Llama, ProLong, Phi-3, and Mistral-Nemo.  The bars vary in height, with the tallest bar, representing gpt-40-40-mini, reaching approximately 98.0%, followed by Qwen2-5-7B-Instruct-1M at 91.7%. The shortest bar, representing Phi-3-medium-128k-instruct, is approximately 1.8%.  The chart features grouped bars, with each color corresponding to a specific model. Notably, the ‘gpt-40’ group has the highest overall performance, while the ‘Mistral-Nemo’ group exhibits the lowest scores, with the Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 2.0%.
